article: 育児中の作業環境（2022年の短い日記）
scope: Read the full Japanese note and all twelve translations, including translated titles/descriptions, the complete anecdote, image reference, dates, and technical terms.
findings: Removed an anomalous duplicate future date from all language versions, retained publication date 2022-09-04, and set lastmod to the review date.
Narrowed descriptions that had promoted this two-sentence personal note into a broader account of remote-work methods or adapter techniques.
Kept the Lightning-to-HDMI adapter as a conditional personal wish; no compatibility claim is made because the iPad model is not specified.
The existing translations accurately retain the nap, focus time, park plan, and conditional wish; no body-text correction was needed.
